requirement: Durable demo orchestration and per-account caps by UTC day

oracle.invariant: Only one revision/site/session/prompt through recovery; only QA PASS reaches Outreach. Bulk is all-or-nothing; replay is not charged again; Retry charges one new slot and keeps the old work. A stale lease does not write; a person who lost access does not continue fill/handoff. Receipts identify the action, not clock order; a failure of the current action does not rebuild/refill by itself. A lost receipt only replays the same build/site, with no extra charge.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/db/index.js:52 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

bulk reserves all its actions atomically; insufficient budget leaves no partial batch
a timeout replay across UTC midnight adopts the same revision/session without charging the new day
a failed build still counts; explicit retry counts once more and retains its work identities
0 removes the limit but keeps usage; a foreign opportunity rolls back the entire batch
a stale or expired worker cannot write a receipt, even before another replica claims it
Steps never count failed content or unverified photos as completed work

acceptance is durable before any effect; two replicas build/fill/handoff once and only QA PASS reaches Outreach

a Retry whose fill fails again stops instead of resuming its own failure
